Strongest test is `workflow_node_retry_maps_into_graph`, because it drives `RegistryConfig::load_workflows` and checks the real `WorkflowGraph` field. Weakest is `workflow_node_retry_parses`, which only checks happy-path deserialization and no cap/absence/invalid cases. Arm B: tests also would fail on pre-change code and the mapping test asserts real graph behavior. Strongest is likewise `workflow_node_retry_maps_into_graph`. Weakest is `workflow_node_retry_parses`, slightly weaker than A because it uses raw `toml::from_str` instead of the config parse entry used elsewhere, so it covers serde but less of the config path. Neither arm adds negative or edge-case tests beyond default `backoff_cap_ms = None`, but the requested tests were both happy-path focused.
